propositions: Every typed configuration field emitted through _SECTION_CLASSES lacks a public_description metadata field, preventing the generated configuration reference from explaining user-visible effects and serving as an external settings contract.
The configuration reference generator does not require or render descriptions, and generated documentation cannot fail validation when descriptions are missing or empty.

Adding public_description metadata to dataclass fields requires module-size management to keep src/rebar/_config_schema.py below the 800-line absolute limit while preserving single-source-of-truth introspection.

Each generated Description cell must articulate a user-visible effect or operational consequence and be manually reviewed against its Key, Type, Default, and Lifecycle cells, attested with reviewer identity and UTC timestamp.
